license_required.quote: no individual shall engage in the practice, or offer to engage in the practice of architecture in this State, or use the title of architect or use any sign, card or device implying that such individual is an architect, or is competent to engage in the practice of architecture, unless such individual holds a currently valid license issued pursuant to this act.

issuing_authority.quote: The Architects Licensure Board established by this act.

name.quote: There is hereby established an Architects Licensure Board

type.quote: There is hereby established an Architects Licensure Board which shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or the director's designee, two members who shall represent the public at large, one member who shall be a certified interior designer, and seven members, all of whom shall be architects

moral_character_required.quote: Any individual of good character, who is a legal resident of Pennsylvania or who is in the employ of or under the direct supervision of an architect licensed with the board

degree_required.value: Professional degree in architecture from an accredited school, or at least six years' practical experience
degree_required.quote: the applicant holds a professional degree in architecture from an accredited school and has obtained at least three years' practical experience in the employ of or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect or as part of the applicant's academic training. In lieu of a professional degree in architecture, the board may accept evidence of at least six years' practical experience

accrediting_body.value: national accrediting body or approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: Any educational institution with an academic program in architecture or interior design services accredited by a national accrediting body or approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: A first professional degree in architecture conferred by an accredited school.

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by a national accrediting body or approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant holds a professional degree in architecture from an accredited school

required.quote: has obtained at least three years' practical experience in the employ of or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect or as part of the applicant's academic training

experience_source.quote: has obtained at least three years' practical experience in the employ of or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect or as part of the applicant's academic training

duration.value: at least three years (or six years in lieu of professional degree)
duration.quote: at least three years' practical experience in the employ of or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect or as part of the applicant's academic training. kind.value: practical experience under supervision of a licensed architect
kind.quote: practical experience in the employ of or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect

exams.name: Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Board may adopt NCARB examination and grading procedures at its discretion
exams.quote: Each applicant for licensing who satisfies subsections (a) and (b) shall submit to a licensing examination. The board may at its discretion adopt the examination and recommended grading procedures adopted by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

interval_years.quote: Each license shall contain the name of the individual to whom it was issued and shall be valid for a period of two years.

required.quote: As a condition of biennial renewal, an architect shall provide the board with documentation of successful completion of a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

period_years.quote: As a condition of biennial renewal, an architect shall provide the board with documentation of successful completion of a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education

topical_requirements.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

available.quote: The board may issue a license, without examination, to any individual who is registered, licensed or certified as an architect in another state or country where the qualifications required are equivalent to those required in this State. The possession of a certificate from the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards shall be prima facie evidence that the individual meets the qualifications required in this State.

requirements.value: Reciprocal license available without examination for architects licensed in another state or country with equivalent qualifications; NCARB certificate is prima facie evidence of meeting qualifications. Alternatively, 10+ years of lawful practice abroad qualifies with a practical examination.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license, without examination, to any individual who is registered, licensed or certified as an architect in another state or country where the qualifications required are equivalent to those required in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bribery, fraud, misstatement or misrepresentation of fact in connection with application for a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Bribery, fraud, misstatement or misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in connection with this application for a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services in violation of the act or its regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in this Commonwealth in violation of any provisions of this act or the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or certificate revoked, suspended, or disciplined by another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice architecture or a certificate to provide interior design services as a certified interior designer revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken by the proper licensing or certificating authority of another state, territory or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services in violation of the board's professional conduct standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in this Commonwealth in violation of the standards of professional conduct established by rules and regulations promulgated by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any individual, partnership, association or corporation to engage in the practice of architecture or interior design services in violation of the act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any individual, partnership, association or corporation to engage in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in violation of any provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bribery, fraud, deceit, recklessness, gross negligence or incompetence in the practice of architecture or provision of interior design services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Bribery, fraud, deceit, recklessness, gross negligence or incompetence in the practice of architecture or in the provision of interior design services as a certified interior designer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper use of an architect's seal or a certified interior designer's number.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of an architect's seal in violation of section 505 or the use of a certified interior designer's number in violation of section 704.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude. Conviction shall include a finding or verdict of guilt, an admission of guilt or a plea of nolo contendere.

definition_quote.value: The rendering or offering to render certain services, hereinafter described, in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. The services referred to in the previous sentence include planning, providing preliminary studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other design documents, construction management and administration of construction contracts.
definition_quote.quote: The rendering or offering to render certain services, hereinafter described, in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. The services referred to in the previous sentence include planning, providing preliminary studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other design documents, construction management and administration of construction contracts.

methods_authorized.quote: planning, providing preliminary studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other design documents, construction management and administration of construction contracts.

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: The certificate issued by the board under Chapter 7 indicating that the individual named is a certified interior designer.

interior_design_services_defined.quote: The rendering or offering to render services in the preparation and administration of documents, including drawings, schedules and specifications which pertain to the design intent and planning of interior spaces, including furnishings, layout, fixtures, cabinetry, lighting and device location and type, finishes, materials and interior construction not materially related to or materially affecting the building systems. The term does not include the practice of architecture.

design_build_authorized.quote: An architectural firm authorized to practice under subsections (a) through (i) will be allowed to offer design-build services consistent with the provisions of section 508(9).

permitted_firm_structures.quote: An individual architect or a group of architects in Pennsylvania may practice architecture in one of the following forms of architectural firms: (1) sole proprietorship; (2) partnership; (3) professional association; (4) professional corporation; (5) business corporation; (6) limited liability company; or (7) limited liability partnership.

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: At least one-third of the partners are licensed under the laws of any state to practice architecture.

firm_design_professional_ownership_minim.quote: At least two-thirds of the partners are licensed under the laws of any state to practice architecture, engineering or landscape architecture.

seal_required.quote: Every architect shall obtain a seal approved by rules and regulations promulgated by the board and shall impress said seal on drawings, specifications and other design documents prepared by the individual or under the architect's personal supervision for use in this State.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: Upon the forfeiture, revocation, suspension or annulment of a license or upon expiration of a license without renewal, an architect shall surrender the architect's seal or stamp to the board.

continuing_education_subject_requirement.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

continuing_education_excluded_topics.quote: The board may not approve courses in office management or practice building for the purpose specified under subsection (e).

continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: The board may waive all or part of the continuing education requirement under subsection (e) for a licensee who provides evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee is unable to complete the requirement due to illness, emergency, hardship or active military service.

exempt_building_types.quote: Nothing contained in this act shall be construed to prohibit: ... (4) The preparation of any drawings or other design documents for detached one-family or two-family dwellings not more than three stories in height and their accessory structures. (5) The preparation of any drawings or other design documents for any utility or farm structure when such utility or farm structure is used in connection with a farm residence. ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: The possession of a certificate from the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards shall be prima facie evidence that the individual meets the qualifications required in this State.

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: The board may at its discretion adopt as its standards for minimum education and experience, the current guidelines on education, training and experience equivalents adopted by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.value: Summary offense; fine not exceeding $500, or imprisonment not exceeding 90 days, or both
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: for a first offense, be guilty of a summary offense and upon conviction thereof shall be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding $500 or suffer imprisonment not exceeding 90 days, or both

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.value: Misdemeanor; fine not less than $2,000 but not more than $5,000, or imprisonment not less than one year but not more than two years, or both
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: for a second or subsequent offense shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction thereof shall be sentenced to pay a fine of not less than $2,000 but not more than $5,000, or to suffer imprisonment of not less than one year, but not more than two years, or both.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: may levy a civil penalty of up to $1,000 on any current licensee or certificate holder who violates any provision of this act or on any person who practices the profession of an architect without being properly licensed
